notes: Use the Compass card for SkyTrain, buses and SeaBus (to North Vancouver). The Canada Line to YVR takes 25 minutes (5 CAD extra). Free shuttles to Capilano and Grouse leave from Canada Place.
Winter is 3-8°C and rainy (Raincouver). Ski at Whistler and Grouse; the Capilano and VanDusen lights run in December; the cherry blossom festival is in April.
The 12% tax is not included in prices, and tips run to 18%. Capilano is pricey at 75 CAD (Lynn is free), Grouse is 80 CAD and the Whistler bus is 50-70 CAD.
Try salmon, sushi (Miku aburi), Japadog and spot prawns (May). Have breakfast at Granville Market.
Book the Whistler bus (Skylynx) days ahead. Peak 2 Peak is cheaper on summer weekdays; combine it with the Sea to Sky Gondola.
Apply for the Canada eTA online. Vancouver is safe; just pass through the Downtown Eastside (Hastings) without stopping.

stops.name: Stanley Park Seawall Bike Ride
stops.tips: Rent a bike from Denny's or Spokes (15 CAD for 2 hours). The seawall is 9 km long and passes under Lions Gate Bridge and by Third Beach.

stops.name: Stanley Park Totem Poles
stops.tips: The totem poles at Brockton Point, a First Nations site.

stops.name: Vancouver Aquarium
stops.tips: Inside the park; sea otters and the Amazon gallery.

stops.name: Prospect Point Cafe
stops.tips: A park cafe with views of the bridge.

stops.name: Coal Harbour Seawall & Canada Place
stops.tips: The terminal with its sail-shaped roof. Try FlyOver Canada (35 CAD) and watch seaplanes take off and land.

backups.name: Cardero's Coal Harbour
backups.tips: A marina restaurant; order the salmon.

backups.name: Vancouver Lookout Harbour Centre
backups.tips: An observation tower; a swap for the aquarium.

stops.name: Granville Island Public Market
stops.tips: An artists' island under the bridge. Try Lee's Donuts and the salmon, and take the Aquabus ferry (5 CAD) to get there.

stops.name: Granville Island Artist Studios
stops.tips: Glass and ceramics, the Net Loft and the Kids Market.

stops.name: Kitsilano Beach
stops.tips: A winter beach walk with snowy mountain views.

stops.name: Sophie's Cosmic Cafe Kitsilano
stops.tips: Retro brunch on 4th Avenue.

stops.name: Museum of Anthropology UBC
stops.tips: Bill Reid's Raven sculpture and totem poles, in a glass building on the UBC campus.

backups.name: Vanier Park & Museum of Vancouver
backups.tips: A space centre and the city museum; a closer alternative to the MOA.

backups.name: Go Fish Granville
backups.tips: A fish taco shack on the dock.

stops.name: Capilano Suspension Bridge Park
stops.tips: A 137 m suspension bridge, plus Treetops and Cliffwalk. A free shuttle runs from Canada Place and is quiet at 09:00. In winter, see the Canyon Lights.

stops.name: Grouse Mountain Skyride
stops.tips: Skiing and snowshoeing in winter, plus sleigh rides. The bears are hibernating.

stops.name: Grouse Mountain Altitudes Bistro
stops.tips: Lunch at the summit with views over the city.

stops.name: Lynn Canyon Park
stops.tips: A free suspension bridge and the 30 Foot Pool; Capilano's free cousin.

backups.name: Lonsdale Quay Market
backups.tips: The market by the SeaBus terminal in North Vancouver.

backups.name: Deep Cove
backups.tips: Rent a canoe or hike to Quarry Rock, and try the Honey Doughnuts. A swap for Lynn.

stops.name: Sea to Sky Highway Shannon Falls
stops.tips: Take the bus (Skylynx or YVR) for 2 hours. On the way, stop at the 335 m waterfall and see the Stawamus Chief.

stops.name: Sea to Sky Gondola Squamish
stops.tips: A gondola up to 885 m, with a suspension bridge and fjord views.

stops.name: Whistler Village
stops.tips: The Olympic village pedestrian zone, with the rings and shops.

stops.name: Peak 2 Peak Gondola
stops.tips: A record-breaking gondola (3 km) between Whistler and Blackcomb. Summit hikes and glacier views in summer, skiing in winter.

stops.name: Purebread Whistler
stops.tips: A legendary bakery for scones and cakes. Then catch the bus back.

backups.name: Brandywine Falls
backups.tips: A 70 m waterfall; a free alternative to the gondola.

stops.name: Gastown Steam Clock
stops.tips: The steam clock whistles every 15 minutes. Look around Gassy Jack Square and its cobblestones.

stops.name: Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Classical Chinese Garden
stops.tips: The first Ming-style garden outside China. The neighbouring park is free.

stops.name: Phnom Penh
stops.tips: Cambodian-Vietnamese food. Order the chicken wings and beef luc lac, and expect a queue.

stops.name: Yaletown
stops.tips: A former warehouse district. See the Roundhouse locomotive, David Lam Park and the False Creek seawall.

stops.name: Japadog Robson
stops.tips: Japanese-style hot dogs (try the terimayo) on Robson Street.

backups.name: Vancouver Art Gallery
backups.tips: The Emily Carr collection; a swap for the police museum.

days.theme: Queen Elizabeth Park and Commercial Drive

stops.name: Queen Elizabeth Park
stops.tips: The city's highest point, with quarry gardens and the skyline. The Bloedel Conservatory costs 8 CAD.

stops.name: VanDusen Botanical Garden
stops.tips: A 22-hectare garden with a maze; the Festival of Lights runs in winter.

stops.name: Main Street Vintage
stops.tips: Vintage and design shops in Mount Pleasant, plus murals (August festival).

stops.name: Commercial Drive
stops.tips: Little Italy. Try the coffee at Cafe Calabria, Havana, and the sandwiches at La Grotta del Formaggio.

stops.name: Trout Lake Park
stops.tips: A neighbourhood lake with a farmers' market on Saturdays.

backups.name: Vij's Restaurant
backups.tips: Canada's famous Indian restaurant on Cambie. No reservations, so expect a queue.

backups.name: Science World
backups.tips: A science museum in a spherical building on False Creek; a swap for the garden (with kids).

stops.name: English Bay Beach
stops.tips: See the A-maze-ing Laughter sculptures and the Inukshuk on a morning walk.

stops.name: Davie Village
stops.tips: Rainbow crosswalks and cafes in the West End.

stops.name: Medina Cafe
stops.tips: The city's most famous brunch spot. Try the waffles and tagine, and expect a queue.

stops.name: Waterfront Canada Line YVR
stops.tips: The Canada Line reaches the airport in 25 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Roedde House Museum
backups.tips: A Victorian house in the West End; a swap for Davie.
